decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API has been on the market for two years with its own page. It is a low-cost extension of the core messaging platform and part of the announced move toward broader enterprise cloud communications, so management will keep it and justify its earlier commitment.

The email to SMS gateway was only launched in 2024 and is publicly presented on its own page. It ties the firm's email and messaging channels together, so any weak uptake will be treated as a temporary ramp-up effect.

The SMS to email gateway is a recent, visibly launched counterpart to Product B and fits the integrated multichannel platform strategy. Management will keep it and attribute disappointing results to the early stage of adoption.
